specversion.quote: Compliant event producers MUST use a value of `1.0` when referring to this version of the specification.

attributeNaming.quote: CloudEvents attribute names MUST consist of lower-case letters ('a' to 'z') or digits ('0' to '9') from the ASCII character set.

recapture: Recapture schema and quotes from the matching cloudevents/spec release tag when the journal targets a CloudEvents release other than v1.0.x.
